knownLimits: Current bridge and culvert elevations unknown; no structure openings
Published CN (GCN10 fair ARCII undrained) used as Smax of SFINCS cnb (CN with SWMM recovery); Ks from POLARIS 0-5 cm, not measured; no measured transmission loss

Terrain is bare-earth lidar: 1 m PimaCounty_2021_B21 and Eastern_PimaCO_2015 in road/wash windows (2015 covers most of the mid/upper Brawley mainstem and San Joaquin/Black Wash); 10 m context mixes all-route-context-v2, 2021, BrawleyRillito 2018 (flown 2019), 2015 and 0.98 km2 of USGS 1/3 arc-second; not a 2026 survey
2021 minus 2015 seam offset about -0.11 m median in 7 road windows; not corrected
6.25 m computational cells are not validated road-depth accuracy; compare cell water-surface elevation zs with road height, never averaged depth
The 27.47 km2 local catchment of 15876941 below USGS 09487000 is excluded; its runoff enters only through the inlet series

Directed network independence does not prove no cross-divide overland exchange; overlaps Gates by 139.42 km2; west-valley subtrees drain toward Northern, which keeps its own NWM inlets (independent model)

Domain v2 (1240 km2) adds the west-valley subtrees of Northern inlets 15876639/653/641/623, Pump Station tributaries 15876613/15876627 and terminal subtrees 15876757/719/669/675; 19 candidate dips (6 >= 1 m, mostly W Silverbell Rd and N Red Hill Rd near 32.445 N) remain in no model
Road heights exist only inside the floodplain-road-heights-v1 tile box (about lon >= -111.44, lat >= 32.146); roads outside it have no comparison
SENSITIVITY v2r: rain 14Z Nov 1..18Z Nov 2 is observed Stage IV 01h (no HRRR); this is an after-the-fact observed-rain test, not something a forecast-time run could have had
SENSITIVITY v3l-obsrain: v2r observed-rain case with the boundaries v3 lobe-tip outflow cells only (5 cells, 52 in all); not calibrated, not tuned to observations, not for live registration

SENSITIVITY v3l-obsrain-cnb-btf: base case B (v3l-obsrain) with TWO changes: (1) inftype cna -> cnb (CN with recovery, seff = smax dry start at 2026-10-30T16Z, POLARIS Ks; infiltration.nc as in v3l-obsrain-cnb) and (2) sfincs.inp btfilter 60.0 -> -1 (SFINCS uvmean boundary memory term off on msk 3 outflow links, as in v3l-obsrain-btf); a candidate combination, not calibrated, not tuned to observations, not for live registration

differences: infiltration.nc (scs -> smax/seff/ks) and sfincs.inp inftype cna -> cnb (identical to v3l-obsrain-cnb, run 42584493432)
baseCase.unchanged: sfincs.nc, sfincs_subgrid.nc, precip_2d.nc, sfincs.dis, sfincs.src, GCN10 files, hydromt.log, native-component.json byte-identical to base B; sfincs.inp differs only on the btfilter and inftype lines

infiltrationChange.label: SENSITIVITY infiltration 2: SCS Curve Number WITH recovery (SFINCS inftype cnb) instead of cna; not tuned to observations; not for live registration
infiltrationChange.hypothesis: cna accumulates all rain from 2026-10-30T16Z as one storm (91% of the Black Wash area past Ia before the Nov 1 14Z burst); cnb starts a new event after each dry spell with S recovered at the SWMM rate, so the Oct 30-Nov 1 showers stop counting as the start of the Nov 1 storm
infiltrationChange.solver: SFINCS f3647fc source/src/sfincs_infiltration.f90 initialize_infiltration_cnb / compute_infiltration_cnb: per face, new event when prcp>0 after a dry step (P1=0, S1=Se); Q=(P1-0.2 S1)^2/(P1+0.8 S1); Se -= infiltration; when dry, after 0.06/kr hours Se += kr*Smax per hour up to Smax; kr = sqrt(ks[mm/hr]/25.4)/75 per hour (SWMM Reference Manual Vol I, eqs 4-36, 4-37). Rain frames are linearly interpolated in time, so a dry spell starts only between two zero frames.

smax.source: base case scs (GCN10 cn_f_ii_2281, fair, ARC II, undrained, inches) * 0.0254; CN source unchanged

seff.choice: seff = smax (fully dry start at tstart 2026-10-30T16Z)
seff.evidence: NCEP Stage IV (IEM archive) over the model box: 24h totals ending 12Z Oct 24..29 domain mean 0.00-0.04 mm (max cell 0.6 mm); 24h ending Oct 30 12Z mean 2.53 mm (max 15 mm); Oct 30 12-16Z mean 1.15 mm (hourly cell maxima 4.6 and 7.1 mm). That ~3.7 mm is not counted (same as the cna base), so the start is slightly too dry (at most ~7% of mean Smax 56 mm).

ks.source: POLARIS v1.0 ksat mean 0-5 cm (Chaney et al. 2019, Water Resour. Res. 55, doi:10.1029/2018WR022797), http://hydrology.cee.duke.edu/POLARIS/PROPERTIES/v1.0/ksat/mean/0_5/ tiles lat3132/lat3233_lon-112-111, log10(cm/hr) -> mm/hr, face-area arithmetic mean, HydroMT-SFINCS 1.2.2 cap 360 mm/hr (0 faces capped), no NaN, no fill

infiltrationChange.builder: tools/sfincs/brawley/variants/build_cnb_infiltration.py, then make_variant.py --inftype cnb (case v3l-obsrain-cnb), then make_variant.py --inp-set btfilter=-1 on that case

boundaryFilterChange.label: SENSITIVITY boundary: btfilter = -1 (uvmean off); not tuned to observations; not for live registration
boundaryFilterChange.hypothesis: At msk 3 outflow links SFINCS adds a running mean of past flux (uvmean, gain up to btrelax/btfilter ~ 61x, ~1 h memory) to the head-driven weakly reflective flux; v2r stored boundary outflow was 2.6-4.4x the head-driven part (docs/upgrade/BRAWLEY-STABILITY-20261109.md 1.3). Turning it off leaves only the head term.
boundaryFilterChange.solver: SFINCS f3647fc source/src/sfincs_boundaries.f90 update_boundary_fluxes: q = ub*h + uvmean (line 1119); lines 1178-1190: if btfilter >= -1e-6 then uvmean = factime*q + facrel*(1-factime)*uvmean else uvmean = 0. uvmean starts at 0 (sfincs_domain.f90:1999) and no rstfile is used, so with btfilter = -1 uvmean is 0 at every step. btfilter is read at sfincs_input.f90:149 (default 60) and is used nowhere else except a NetCDF output attribute (sfincs_ncoutput.F90:1967).
boundaryFilterChange.scope: This mesh has mask 1 (643004 faces) and 3 (52 faces) only; no water-level (msk 2) or river (msk 5) boundaries, no bndfile/bzsfile/bdrfile, no wavemaker, so the change acts only on the msk 3 outflow links.
boundaryFilterChange.physicalSource: The head term is the boundary's own long-wave outflow speed sqrt(g h) times the head over the outflow cell bed; with no downstream water to sustain a jet at a dry open outfall, the memory term has no physical counterpart.
